blurb: Guests travel by Jeep on private tours through Cape Breton's back roads, mountain routes, and coastal views. Tours include storytelling, light exploration, and stops for photography and nature appreciation. Some tours combine Jeep travel with guided fly fishing on the Margaree River.
extraNote: All tours are private · Tours run in most weather conditions; Jeeps provide protection from elements · Cancellation policy accommodates cruise ship schedule changes · Base location in Margaree; pickup from Sydney Cruise Port available for some tours
